title: novosieversia glacialis
intro: Novosieversia glacialis, commonly known as the snow lotus or blue poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family. It is native to the high-altitude regions of the Himalayas. The health benefits of Novosieversia glacialis include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities.
